name: Pre-Release Validation
description: Full pre-release readiness. All items must pass.

items.check: Game.php under 300 lines, zero SQL? Managers own one aggregate each?
items.fail: Game.php over 300 lines or Manager ownership violated
items.fix: Extract into Managers. Fix cross-Manager writes.

items.check: Every non-GAME state has zombie? giveExtraTime on turns?
items.pass: All states have zombies, giveExtraTime wired
items.fail: A state lacks zombie or giveExtraTime missing

items.check: All tables InnoDB with FK and atomic conditional UPDATEs?
items.pass: All tables InnoDB with FK and atomic UPDATEs
items.fail: Table uses MyISAM, lacks FK, or non-conditional UPDATE
items.fix: Change to InnoDB. Add FK. Use WHERE with expected state.

items.check: Every action under 15 lines with five responsibilities in order?
items.pass: All actions under 15 lines, correct structure
items.fail: Action over 15 lines or wrong responsibility order

items.check: Client handlers registered and idempotent? getAllDatas delegates?
items.fail: Handler unregistered or getAllDatas missing delegation
items.fix: Register per CLNT-006. Delegate per SYNC-001.

items.check: Mutations log old values? Undo reverses LIFO?
items.pass: All mutations undoable with LIFO reversal
items.fail: Mutation lacks old-value logging or undo not LIFO
items.fix: Add old-value logging. Verify LIFO within checkpoints.

items.check: Managers, scoring, and abilities have tests? Hidden info protected?
items.pass: Test coverage meets requirements, hidden info protected
items.fail: Missing test or hidden info exposed
items.fix: Add tests per TEST-002, TEST-003. Audit payloads per CORE-005.
